Catalog number : M00293 Uniform title: kālīkalpalatā Secondary title: dakṣiṇakālīkalpalatā Author : vimarśānandanātha Manuscript : NGMCP 5-6521 reel number: B 120/9 Description: Kālīkalpalatā, also called Dakṣiṇakālīkalpalatā by Vimarśānandanātha is concerned with the ritual procedures for the worship of the goddess Dakṣiṇakālī and her consort Mahākāla. This form of Kālī is especially popular in Bengal. First presented by āgamakṛṣṇavāgīśa in his Bṛhattantrasāra written in the sixteenth century in Bengal, the Kālīkalpalatā post-dates it. The ritual procedure is described in sufficient detail to be able to perfom the ritual. It is divided into two sections (kusuma literally -flowers-) The first deals with the preliminary purifications, bathing and offering of libations. The second describes the puujaa itself. text.body:
<1a>
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
praṇamya dakṣiṇāṃ kālī sṛṣṭisthitilayātmikāṃḥ | vakṣye tasyāḥ saparyā vai pradāyānusārataḥ || 1 ||
brahmye murūnutte(?) cotthāya vahva padmāsanaḥ kulavṛkṣaṃ praṇamya śirasi daivata sahasradalakamalakarṇikā madhyavarti caṃdramaṃḍalāṃtargataṃ svaguru dhyāyeta || yathā |
raktaṃ raktavilepamālyavasanaṃ yāmena raktosalaṃ vibhūtyā priyayetareṇatarasāśliṣṭhaṃ prasannānanaṃ | hastābhyāṃ mabhayaṃ varaṃ ca dadhvataṃ śaṃbhusrarūpaṃ(?) paraṃ ānaṃdākiṃta locano lapugaṃdhyāye cchirasthaṃ guruṃḥ | iti dhyātvā manasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hare saphraṃ haskṣmaṃ(?) lvryūṃ śkhphreṃ śkṣma lkṣmīṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ śrī(-)amukānaṃdanātha śrī amuka devyaṃ vā śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ||
iti gurupādukāmaṃtraṃ daśadhā saptadhā (*?) vā prajapya śrīgurordakṣiṇākare guhyātiguhyagoptītvaṃ gṛhāṇasmatkṛtaṃ japāṃ siddhi bhavatu me deva tva prasādān maheśvareti ||
samarpya daṃḍavat praṇāmaṃ bhūmau kuryāt ḥ | praṇāma maṃtro yathāḥ |
aṃkhaṃḍamaṃḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ ||
iti praṇamyastu vīta namaste nātha bhagavāna śivāya gururūpiṇe vādyāvatārasaṃsidhyai svīṣṭānyaneka vigrahaḥ |
<1b>
naṃcāya navarūpāmaparamārtheka rūpiṇeḥ | sarvajñāna tayo bheda bhāna tridanāṃpetaḥ ||
svataṃtrāpadayākḷpta vigrahāya śivātmane | paratatrāya bhaktānāṃ bhaṣyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇeḥ ||
puvivekināṃ(?) vivekāya vimarśāya vimarśināḥ | prakāśānāṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇeḥ ||
purastāt pāśvayo pṛṣṭe namaskuryāmuparyayaḥ | sadāmacittarūpeṇa vidhe hi navadāsanaṃ ||
iti stutvā natvā tadājñāṃ gṛhitvā mūlādhārastha trikoṇāṃ tavagādho mukha śiva liṃgaveṣṭinī prasupta bhujagākārāṃ śaṃkhyavartākāreṇa sārdha trivalayāṃ taḍitkoṭi prabhāṃ nīvāra ||
śūkavadvigrahāṃ bhūlaṃvidhā prakṛtirbhūtīmiti kurvavījena vikoṇāgninā sacetanāṃ | kṛtvā suṣumṇa valītā dvādaśāṃtaṃ nītvā brahmaraṃdhraraṃ | dhva(?)sthasahasradalakamala sphanasada | śivena saṃyo tatrasya caṃdramaṃḍalādvigaladamṛtadhārayāsaṃ | tarpa tatraiva natprabhāyāṃ nijaguruṃ dhyāyet | yathāḥ |
kulāmṛtarasollona hṛdayāccūrṇa locanātaḥ | kulāliṃga na saṃbhinnaṃ cūrṇitaśiṣatāmasāna | kulaśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtānāṃ pūrṇonaḥ karaṇau (*?) tanuḥ ||
<2a>
varābhayayutāt sarvāt kulataśarthavedinaḥ ||
iti dhyātvā ||
oṃ prahlādānaṃdanātha namaḥ | sakalānaṃdanāthaya namaḥ || kumārānaṃdanāthaya namaḥ || vasiṣṭānaṃdanāthaya namaḥ | krodhānaṃdanāthāya namaḥ | suṃdarānaṃdanāthaya namaḥ | dhyānānaṃdanāthāya namaḥ | vodhānaṃdanāthāya namaḥ | sukānaṃdanāya namaḥ | iti matvā ṛṣyādi karaṣaḍaṃga nyāsaḥ pūrvakaṃ hṛdayakamale dvādaśe dale kuṃḍalinaṃ | mānīyaṃ devīrūpeṇa vakṣamāṇa prakāreṇa ||
dhyātvā mānasairgaṃdhāyupavāraubhyarcyaḥ | krī dakṣiṇāye vidmahe hrūṃvāṃmuḍādyai dhīmahi | tatraḥ kālī pracodayat | gāyatrīṃ maṣṭāviśanivāraṃ japtvā mūlamaṃtraṃ śatavāraṃ prajapya
guhyāti guhyagoptītvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ | siddhirbhavatu me devī tvatprasādānmaheśvarī ||
iti maṃtreṇa vāmakaraṇe samarpyastu tvānna tva devyājñā prarthayeta | trailokya caitanyamapi triśakte he viśvamātarbhavadājñayaivaḥ | prātaḥ samutthāya tava priyārthaṃ sāsārajātrāmannuvartapiṭhye iti prārthya kuṃḍalinī punaste naiva yathā mūlādhāramānīya tadātmyaṃ vibhāvayediti ||
<2b>
atha śrutau prakāśamānāṃ prathame prayāṇe pratiprayāṇepya mṛtāyamānāṃḥ | ataḥ padavyāmanusaṃvaraṃtīmānaṃdarūpāmavalāṃ prapadyeḥ || iti kuḍalinī bhāvanāḥ ||
ahaṃ devī na cānyosmi vrahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk | sacidānaṃdarūpena māhātmanamiva ciṃtayet ||
iti gurudevyātmanāmaikyaṃ vibhāṣyaḥ |
samadraṃ mekhale devī parvatastanamaṃḍale | viṣṇupatnī namastubhyaṃ pādasparśaṃ kṣamasva me |
iti śvāsānusāreṇa bhūmau pādaṃ datvā vahinirṛtyāvaśakaṃ nirvartyaśuvibhūtvā devī gṛhaṃ gatvā nirmālyamapraptārya praṇamyāṃjñā gṛhītvā snānārtha tīrthaṃ gacchetaḥ ||
iti prāta kṛtyaḥ ||
etadāvaśyakameva kartavyamakaraṇai pratyavāya śravaṇat | taduktaṃ rudrayāmaleḥ |
prātaḥ kṛtvamakṛtvā tu yo devī bhaktitorcayet | tasya pūjā tu viphalā śaucahīnā yathā krīyā ||
atha snānaṃ |
devī rūpanātmānaṃ bhāvayanatīrthānike gatvā mūlena mṛttikāyāṃga vilepanaṃ vidhāya svarṇarajatamudrā rūpaḥ | na kuśān saṃgṛhya sarvaṃ devī rūpaṃ vibhāvyamulamuccaranmalāpakarṣaṇaṃ snātvā ācamya jalapūrṇātāśrapātre tilākṣatajayāpuṣpāṇi nikṣipyate na saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt |
<3a>
oṃ adyetyādi amuka devatā prītaye maṃtrasthānamahaṃ kariṣye |
iti saṃkalpa jale trikoṇaṃ vilikhya |
gaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvatī | narmade siṃdhukāverījalesmin sanidhi kuru ||
iti maṃtreṇa tīrthānyāvāhya sūryamaṃḍalādalaṃkuśamudryāa | tato mūlā te mūlavījāṃte vā ātmatatvāhāmūvidyāṃ tatvāya svāhā sūśivanatvāya svāhā ityārapyā athavā oṃ hrīṃ svāhā ityanenaṃ vā strirācamya ātmānaṃ triḥsaṃprokṣyalenamṛttikūpāṃga vilepanaṃ kṛtvā śvavarṇādīni saptachidrāṇī saṃnirudhya trirnimajjena mūlaṃ smaranatayeva trirācamya mūlena kumākhya mudrayā trirmūrdhvajalenābhi pivediti maṃtrasnānaṃ | taduktaṃ kumārī taṃtreḥ | vedāṃdyanaṃ tathā māyā svāhetyāvamataṃ smṛtamiti athe vaidikī saṃdhyānaṃtaraṃ maṃtrasaṃdhyāṃ karmāt || taduktaṃ |
ukte naiva vidhānena kṛtvā snānataṃtaraṃtrikaṃ(?) | vaidīkīṃ tāṃtrikīṃ saṃdhyā kṛtvā tarpaṇamācaret ||
tata tāṃtrikasaṃdhyā yathā | tataśca tavāsasī parīdhāyaḥ | aṃmaṇi pariṇi vajiṇi mahāpratisare rakṣarakṣaṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā | iti maṃtreṇa śikhāvākṣvā(?) mūlena tilakaṃ ||
<3b>
yadravyaṃmabhimatrya lalāṭavaḥ | udvayamūle hṛdaye cava śakti lakṣaṇa cihnitaṃ tilakaṃ kuryāḥ | chakti lakṣaṇaṃ vihṇītāṃ svakalpokta vidhānena ijyanena pāśavastu śuddhamṛdarśnihotra bhasmādinā | virakalpe tu citābhasma tanmṛstekapā vā | mūrdhvalena pūrvokta prayogenā camya | krīmibhi vījeṇa prānāthāmaśyaṃ vidhāyakratthādi karaṣaḍaṃga nyāsā | kṛtvā vāmena nalamādāya dahakṣastena pidhāya haṃparaṃ laṃva iti tridhāmidhāya aṃgulmaṃtaṇajadviṃdubhi mūlamaccarana saptadhā tatvamudrayā mūrddhni prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā'vaśeṣaṃ jalaṃ dakṣahaste nidhāyanāsā samupanīya vāmanāsāyāṃtarā kṛṣyadehāṃtarvṛtti samastapāpaṃ tena prakṣālya kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tajjalaṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭena haste upaviṣṭaṃ vicityapuṭaḥ kalpita vajrapāṣāṇe oṃ kraḥ astrāya phaṭ iti kṣiptvā mūlenonniṣṭha sūryāyā galitrayaṃ datvā | kālikā vai vigrahasmajñānavāsinyai dhīmahī | tanno ghore pracodayāt |
iti gāyatrimaṣṭottaraśataṃmaṣṭāviṃśativāraṃvādaśavāraṃ dhāṣṭau vājayekṣitimatra saṃdhyāḥ |
<4a>
atha tarpaṇaṃ |
tatrādau jaleṣṭadalaṃ pīṭaṃ vibhāvya tatrā (*?)ṣṭāvaṣṭa dikṣekāṃ madhye ca navapīṭhaśaktistarpayet | yathā'iṣṭā tarpayāmi jñānāṃta śaktiyā ikāminīva (4) kāmadā vinītaṃ (5) ravinaṃdaranipriyāṃta (7) ānaṃdāṃta (8) karmaṇaiḥkāmadhyai manonmīnīta | iti saṃtarpanaṃ | tatastasīṭe parivakṣyamānaṃ devī yatra vibhāvya tarpaṇeya devatā ihāyāṃ tvityā vāhūṃ | oṃ brahmabhairavastṛpyatāṃ | oṃ viṣṇubhairavastṛ(0) | oṃ rudrabhairavastṛ(0) | hasakṣamalavarayūṃ ānaṃdabhairavāya vauṣaṭ | ānaṃdabhairavastṛpyatāṃ | hasakṣamalavarayī sudhādevyai vauṣaṭ | ānaṃdabhairavītaḥ | iti devatarpaṇaṃ | atharṣi tarpaṇaṃ | oṃ mahādevyaṃ vāḷ oṃ mahādevanaṃdanāthastṛ oṃ tripurāṃ vā tṛ oṃ bhairavānaṃdanāthastṛ iti divyaigha | oṃ vighnānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ pūrṇānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ valacittāṃnaṃdanāthastṛpyatāṃ | oṃ calācalānaṃdanāthastṛ0 | oṃ kumārānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ krodhānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ varānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ smaradīpanānaṃdanāthastṛ |
<4b>
magāyāvātṛ | oṃ māpāvatyaṃvātṛ | ete siddhauyāḥ | oṃ vimalānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ kuśalānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ bhīmasenānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ sudhākarānaṃdanāthastṛ | bhīmānaṃdanāthastṛ | aṃgorakṣānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ bhojadevānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ prajāpatyānaṃdanāthastṛ | oṃ samayānaṃdanātastṛ | oṃ saṃtoṣānaṃdanāthastṛ | iti mānavaighā | atha pitṛtarpaṇaḥ | guru parama guru parāpara guru parameṣṭhī gurunāṃ naṃdanātha śabdānāṃstarpayet | idaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tu gurau paralokāgate | iha sthite tu tatsaṇamātraṃ | tataḥ saparivārāṃ devīṃ tatra dhyātvā gaṃdhādibhirabhyarcya mūlavidhāte mahākālasahite dakṣiṇe kālike mātastṛpyatāṃ | iti daśavāraṃ trivāraṃ vā saṃtarpya mahākālaṃ viḥsaṃparivārasahitadevatāstarpayet | yathā ||
āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hṛdaya devatāṃ tarpayāmi | krāṃ śirase svāhā śirodevatāṃt | kru śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | śikhā devatāṃ tarpa | krai kaṃcavāya hūḥ kavacadevatāṃ tarpaḥ | krau netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | netradevatāṃ tarpa | kraḥ rustrāya phaṭ | astradevatāṃ tarpayāmi |
<5a>
svaheti sarvatradamiti saṃpradāyaḥ | tato mūlamaṃtramuccārya prathamāvaraṇāmikāṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāṃ tarpayāmi | iti mūladevī tarpamitvā tato dvitīyāvaraṇa tarpaṇaṃ | oṃ kālīṃtaḥ oṃ kapālilīṃtaḥ oṃ kullāta | oṃ kurukullāṃta oṃ virodhinī laṃḥ avipracittātaḥ oṃ umātātaḥ oṃ umaprabhātaṃ oṃ dīkṣātaḥ oṃ nīlāṃtaḥ oṃ ghanāṃtaḥ oṃ valākātaḥ | mātrāṃtaḥ | oṃ mudrāṃtaḥ | oṃ mināṃtaḥ | tato mūlamūccārya dvitaṃyāvaraṇāṃsmikāṃ śrīkāli tarpayāmīti saṃtarpya tṛtīyāvaraṇā tarpaṇaṃ oṃ āṃ vrāhmīta oṃ aḥ nārasihītaṃ tato mūlamuccārya tṛtīyāvaraṇātmikāṃ śrīkālikāṃ tarpayāmi tataścaturthāvaraṇa tarpaṇaṃ | aiṃ hrīṃ aṃ asitāṃga bhairavaṃta aiṃ hrīṃ irubhairavaṃta aiṃ hrīṃ uṃ caṃḍabhairavaṃta aiṃ hrīṃ krodhabhairavaṃtaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ ḷ unmatabhairavaṃta aiṃ hrīṃ aikapālabhairavaṃta aiṃ hrīṃ auṃ bhīṣaṇabhairavaṃta aiṃ hrīṃ aḥ saṃhārabhairavaṃ tarpyamūlamuccarya caturthāvaraṇātmikāṃ śrīkālikāṃ tarpayāmītiḥ ||
<5b>
tataḥ paṃcāvaraṇa tarpaṇaṃ | oṃ i iṃtaraṃ agniṃ namayamaṃtakṣa nairṛtita vaṃ varuṇaṃttayaṃ vāyuṃta śaṃ śomaṃta haṃ īśānaṃta hrīṃ anaṃtataḥ oṃ brahmaṇaṃta mūlamuccārya paṃcamāvaraṇātmikāṃ śrīkālikāṃ tarpayāmitī |
tataḥ ṣaṣṭāvaraṇa tarpaṇaṃ vaṃjraṃta śaṃ śaktiṃtaḥ idaṃ daṃḍaṃ tarpayāmi khaṃ khaḍgaṃta paṃ paṃ śaṃnaḥ a aṃkuśaṃ tarpayāmi gaṃ gaṃdātaṃ triṃ triśulaṃta caṃ cakraṃta paṃ padmaṃ mūlamuccārya ṣaṣṭāvaraṇātmikāṃ śrīkālikāṃ tarpayāmi | tataḥ oṃ khaḍgaṃta oṃ muḍaṃta oṃ varaṃta oṃ abhayaṃta ityuttama tarpaṇaṃ | athavāpī (*?) śaktīnāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mūlenāṣṭottara śataṃ vā aṣṭāviśativāraṃ tha tarpā ṣaḍaṃga devatā maṃtraṃ tarpaditi | tato hrīṃ hasaḥ mārta | oṃ bhairavāya prakāśaka śaktisahitāya idamarghaṃ svāheti triḥsūryayārghyaṃ datvā sūryamaṃḍale devīṃ vibhāvya mūlāṃte udyadāditva maṃḍalavattinyai śivacaitanyamayai mahākāla sahitayai idamarghya svāheti maṃteṇa raktacaṃdanajavāpuṣpakuśākṣatapiripūrṇena tāmrapātreṇa sūryamaṃḍalasthāyai devyai arghye datvā mūlaṃ yathā śaktyā prajapya guhyeti maṃtrena samarpya suryamaṃḍale
<6a>
devī smaraṇa pūrvakaṃ snānuṃjalāśaye gatvā malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snānaṃ vidhāya oṃ adyetyādi saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā devyātmakaṃ tejorūpaṃ jalavibhāvya mūlamuccāra trimajya punarācamya mūlena śikhāṃ spṛṣṭvā ṛṣyādi ṣaḍaṃganyāsa vidhāya prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā prātarnavavāraṃ madhyāhne ṣaṭtriṃśadvāraṃ sāmyaṃ ṣoḍaśavāraṃ mūlaṃ gāyatrīṃ vātapitvā vaidika tarpaṇaṃ nataraṃ mūlā tesāṃgāṃ sarparivāsaṃ sāyudhāṃ mahākāla sahitāṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāṃ tarpayāmi svāeti triḥsaṃtarpya oṃ hrīṃ haṃsā iti maṃtreṇa sūryāmarghye datvā yathā śaktyā mūlaṃ japtvā devīṃ visṛjya śuddhapātre tīrthodakaṃ gṛhītvā devyālayaṃ gacchaditi |
[iti śrīvimarśānaṃdanātha viracitāyāṃ dakṣiṇakālīkalpalatāyāṃ prathamaṃ kusumaṃ] ||
atha pūjāvidhi |
tatra yathā kāmanayāvastradvayaṃ paridhāyastrovantilakaṃ datvā pūjāgṛhasamīpamāgatyaḥ sūryaḥ somāyamaḥkālo mahābhūtāni paṃcava | ete śubhāśubhasyeha karmaṇo navasākṣiṇa devī vaṃ prākṛtaṃ citraṃ pāpākrāṃtaḥ ||
<6b>
mabhūnmama | tanniḥsārayavinnānme pāpaṃ phaṭ phaṭ te namaḥ | iti maṃtradvayena pāphonsādanaṃ kṛtvā oṃ vajrarekhe hu phaṭ svāheti maṃtreṇa jalamānīyājanamabhyukṣepaviśya | oṃ viśuddhasarvapāpāniśamayāśeṣavikalmānapanahaṃ iti maṃtreṇa hastau pādau prakṣālya oṃ hrīṃ svāheti maṃtreṇa campā śikhāvaṃdhanamakṛtaṃ cette naiva maṃtreṇa śikhāvaṃdhanaṃ vidhāya sāmānyārghyasthapayet | yathā ||
trikaṇavṛttacaturasramaṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā oṃ hrīṃ ādhāraśakteye namaḥ iti saṃpūjyādhāraṃ nidhāyaṃ oṃ asrā phaṭ iti pātraṃ prakṣālyādhāre nidhāya oṃ krīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iti maṃtreṇāpūryapūrvavartīrthānyā vāhyaḥ oṃmiti gaṃdhādi na kṣipyayati dhenu mudraṃ pradarśyayediti sāmānyarghya | tenodakena caturdhārāṇi saṃprokṣaṃneṣu devatāḥ pūjayeta | dvārodvegaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ vāme kṣetrapālāya namaḥ dakṣineva vaṭukāya namaḥ adhāre yogīnībhyo namaḥ ||
<7a>
eva krameṇaṃ gaṃgāyai namaḥ yamunāyai namaḥ śrīlakṣmyai namaḥ sarasvatyai namaḥ ||
evaṃ pūrvādi dvārāṇi pūjayetaḥ | tata dvārapāde vadesya dvāri rakṣa tu | vārayan viprasaṃśatamityājñā parameśvarī | iti devājñāṃ śrāvayitvā vāmāṃga saṃkoca pūrvakamaṃḍapātaḥ praṣaśyaḥ ||

namaste devadeveśi sarvatṛptikaraṃ paraṃ || amṛtānaṃdaṃ saṃpūrṇe gṛhāṇa jalamuttamaṃ ||

<57a>
pīṭhauparisaṃyojyā vahniṃ(?) visarjayet ||

eṣa vali mahākālāya namaḥ || iti mahākāla valimapritvā tatastṛptāṃ devīṃ jñātvā dhenumudrayā jalamatṛtīkṛtya amṛtāpidhānamasi svāhā iti devyā haste jalaṃ dadyāt ||
<57b>
tatoṃ āpaprāśitāvibhāmavedyaṃ naiṛtyā hraṃ iti saṃsthāpyaṃ hastaprakṣālanādikaṃ kārayitvā mūlāte śrīmahākāla sahitāyai dakṣiṇakalikāyai tāṃvūlaṃ parikalpayāmi namaḥ || tamaladala kapūrapūgitāgataṃraṃgitāṃ ||
saṃśoṣitaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ ca tāṃvūlaṃ parigṛhyatāmiti tatvamudrayā nivedya tataḥ sāṣṭadala godhūmapiṣṭadiravitadāpādi saddhitaṃ svarṇaravitaṃtra madāyacakramudrāṃ pradarśya dhenu mudrayāmṛṣī kṛtya mūlenābhya a oṃ mastakaṃ punolyamūlete || mastayoginī cakra parivāragaṇānvite | aṇatrikaṃ gṛhāṣodakālike munasiddhaye || anena maṃtreṇa ghaṃṭādi vāhana pūrvake prārāvana sramākāraṃ uccai devīnī rājapet || mūlavījena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūrvokta ṛṣyadi ṣaḍaṃga nyāsānvidhāya ||
<58a>
japamālāmānīyakvacisātre vāmahaste vā sthāpayet | mūlonāryodake nābhiṣicya ||
māle māle mahāmāye sarvaśakti svarūpiṇī | catuvarṇatyapinyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava ||
ityanena maṃtreṇa gaṃdha puṣpābhyāṃ saṃpūjya || oṃ gaṃ avighnaṃ kuru māletve iti maṃtreṇa dakṣahastenadāya śirasi guruṃ || kaṃṭhe maṃtrapītavarṇa | hṛdaye tveṣṭa devatāṃ dhyāyan hṛdayetvaṣṭa devatāṃ dhyāyan hṛdayasamīpa mālāmādāya dakṣahasta madhyamāguli madhyaparvaṇi saṃsthāpyaṃ || oṃ hrīṃ smīṃ hraṃ mahākālāya hauṃ mahādevāya krāṃ kālikāyai hau iti mahākāla maṃtraṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tajjapaphalaṃ mahākāla haste naivedya || tatrādau kullukāṃ mūrddhni vinyasyasetu hṛdaye dhyātvā mahāsetuṃ viśuddhau sahasrāre ca dhyātvā nirvrāṇaṃ maṇipūre vinyasya ||
<58b>

<59a>
trayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādi karaṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ vidhāya devyā vāmahaste adyodakena japāṃ guhyāti guhyagotvaṃ gṛhāṇasma kṛtaṃ japaṃ siddhirbhavatu me devī tvat prasādān maheśvarī || iti samarpya devyai puṣpāṃjali datvā tato hrīṃ siddhai namaḥ || iti paṃcāramaṃtreṇa mālāṃ saṃpūjya rahasi sthāpayediti ||
tato karpūstavena stutvā kṣau iḍānārikerāṃvuphala iveṣu yathāmābhaṃ nivedaye || natvā mūlena upacārā samarpyā || taduktaṃ || pradakṣiṇanarnā kuryāt kapūrastutiyāmāpāṭan || iti tatastova kavacasahasranāmādikaṃ paṭhitvā pradakṣiṇa namaskārān vidhāya tataśculakākādakena itaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇavuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgrat svapnapusyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padmāmudareṇa
<59b>

mūlāte gacchagaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthāne parameśvarī || yatra brahmādayo devāna viduḥ paramaṃ padamiti ||
tejasaḥ nirmālyaḥ puṣpaṇa saṃhāramudrayā samudhṛjyāghrāyapūrakayogena hṛdaya mānīya manasā saṃpūjya kṣaṇaṃ tadātmya vibhāvya tattejaḥ kuṃḍalinī rūpaṃ pariṇa taṃtra mūlādhāre sthāpayediti || taduktaṃ svataṃtre ||
tatastu dakṣiṇā devyā deheṣvā vṛttibhedanaḥ | vilināḥ saṃtu mūlena devyaṃge nihitāḥ smarediti ||
<60a>
tato ṛsyādikara ṣaḍaṃganyāsan kṛtvā eśānyāṃ jalena trikoṇa caturasra maṃḍalaṃ nirmāyatannirmālyena saṃpūjya tatra oṃ caṃḍeśvaryai namaḥ || iti gaṃdhādibhiḥ saṃpūjya naivedya datāṃśaṃ sahasrāṃśaṃ samuddhṛtya tajjale naiva naivedyādi tanmaṃtreṇena dadyāt || tato valipātrastha devatā narā ca mudrayā visṛjya valivisanaṃ kuryāt || yathā ||

<60b>
ityachidramavadhārya viśeṣārghaṃ vālayitvānatra puṣpaṃ datvā tada snigdha bhūmau vā hastakaniṣṭayā māyāṃ vilikhya mūlātoyaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmipadinayaṃ ya paśyāmi vakṣaṣāṃ ||
saṃ evadāsatāṃ pātu yadi śakra samā bhavet ||
iti maṃtreṇa tilakaṃ kṛtvā yatra lepaṃ nirmālyaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā aviśiṣṭaṃ nirmālyaṃ śuvideśe nikṣipya devī (*?) pamātmānaṃ dhyāyediti nityapūjā || athaivaṃ vistaraṃ kartuṃ maśakra śveta prātarusthāyaśaucādikaṃ vidhāya gurudevīṃ smṛtvā praṇamya uktavidhinā snātvā snāne nistārā śaktau malāpakarṣaṇa snānaṃtaraṃ mūlavījena kuṃbhamudrayā svaśirasi triḥprokṣya ||
uktavidhinā saṃdhyā tarpaṇāni kṛtvā tadakaṇe aśaktaḥ mūlaṃ navavāraṃ prātaḥkāle madhya hri ṣaṭtriśadvāraṃ sāyaṃ ṣaḍaśavāraṃ prajapya mūlenāṣṭāviṃśanivāraṃ devī saṃtarpyā mūlena sūryāghaṃ dānaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ gatvā prāgukta prakāreṇa maṃḍala pūjāṃvidhāya tadaśāktau mūlena maṃḍaprokṣa ||
<61a>
tatrāsanaṃ kalpayitvā || hrīṃ ādharaśakti kamalāsanāya nama ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjyopasiśyā prāṇa na dravyāṇyācchādhā bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya bhūtaśudhyāmapi vistarā śaktau || prāgvanyāya puruṣaṃ dhyātvā yamiti vījena prāṇāyāmena tadehaṃ saṃśopyaraṃ iti vījena saṃdahyavavaṃ vījena saṃplāvya devyārūpaṃ sāvarṣahaṃ dehamutpannaṃ vibhāvya īṃ iti maṃtreṇa dvādaśāvṛtti japena prāṇamratiṣṭāṃ vidhāya saṃvīnyāsāt kṛtvā tadaśaktau ṛṣyādika khaḍaṃgamaṃtrākṣānyāsān vidhāya pūrvokra yogapīṭhaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tadaśaktau navapīṭhaṃ śaktirvinyasya pūrvoktena dhyātvā pūrvoktarītyāṃtaryāgaṃ vidhāya tadaśaktau dhyātvā mūlena paṃcopacārairādhya || kṣaṇaṃ tadātmyaṃ vibhāvya mudrāḥ pradarśya pūrvokta kalaśapātrāṇyācchāda kalasyāvanā
<61b>

<62>

<63>
saṃpūjya ekaṃ arghyaṃ saṃsthāpyamaṃdaśakalātmane vahnimaṃḍalāya namaḥ ādhāre iti saṃpūjya tadupari astreṇa kṣālite pātraṃ nidhāyaṃ || haṃ dvādaśa kalātmane sūryamaṃḍalāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tanmadhye viloma mūlamuccāryavajamuccarana vā jalenāpūrya kicitpātrātare tajjalaṃ gṛhītvāti pūjopakaranamātmānaṃntiḥ prokṣya prāgvatrava pīṭhaśaktīḥ pretāsanaṃ ca saṃpūjya prāgvadāvāhya vījena upacārā prakalpa || prāgvat pūjayitvā | naivedyāṃte prāgvalitrayaṃ datvā prāgvajatvā udvāsayeditatīyaḥ kalpaḥ ||
